title: Land Reforms 2.0 will not benefit landless: Bhoo Avakasha Samithi
description: The team entrusted with implementing ‘Land Reforms 2.0’ is focussed on examining the legality of converting plantations into multi-crop land, determining the extent of landholdings, and easing land acquisition for public projects; it has not been mandated to address the pressing concerns of the landless, says forum
